When you visit our website, we store cookies on your browser to collect information. #### Strictly Necessary Cookies

If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

#### Social Media Cookies

#### Your Privacy

When you visit our website, we store cookies on your browser to collect information. The information collected might relate to you, your preferences or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to and to provide a more personalized web experience. However, you can choose not to allow certain types of cookies, which may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings according to your preference. You cannot opt-out of our First Party Strictly Necessary Cookies as they are deployed in order to ensure the proper functioning of our website (such as prompting the cookie banner and remembering your settings, to log into your account, to redirect you when you log out, etc.). For more information about the First and Third Party Cookies used please follow this link.

#### Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

#### Functional Cookies

#### Performance Cookies

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

#### Social Media Cookies

- [x] Social Media Cookies Inactive

These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests. This may impact the content and messages you see on other websites you visit. If you do not allow these cookies you may not be able to use or see these sharing tools.

# About Us

![Image 1: Plates of Side Caesar Salad, Creamy Cheddar Mac and Cheese, and a side bowl of parmesan cheese. Fork on a napkin](https://www.noodles.com/sites/default/files/styles/super_large/public/2026-08/AboutUs-Desktop.jpg.webp?itok=Iet0ny0x)

![Image 2: Plates of Side Caesar Salad, Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese and a side bowl on parmesan cheese](https://www.noodles.com/sites/default/files/styles/medium/public/2026-08/About_Us_Mobile.jpg.webp?itok=FG-GwON9)

## Our Story

At Noodles & Company, we know noodles. For 30 years, we’ve been perfecting the art of crafting craveable, expertly prepared noodle dishes. We enable moments of comfort and connection through the power of the noodle. Whether it’s a quick bite on the go, a cozy meal shared with family or a new flavor discovery, we’re here to deliver a feel-good experience. Our menu is built on flavorful variety, expertise and a passion for the world’s most beloved comfort food.

## Our Food

Noodles are easy to make, but hard to make well. At Noodles & Company, we’ve spent three decades refining recipes, developing cooking techniques and curating a menu that satisfies every craving with the perfect bite, every time. Our commitment to quality means we sauté each bowl to order, bringing together fresh ingredients and bold flavors with precision and care.

![Image 3: Preview](blob:http://localhost/17e873ca4916b282adba1f4723e2aedd)

![Image 4: sauteing rigatoni rosa noodles over an open flame and cross section of spinach](https://www.noodles.com/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/2025-03/Saute%20pan%20and%20spinach.png.webp?itok=nDLoHEpc)

We’re the only restaurant devoted entirely to noodles, offering a menu that blends classic comfort with contemporary innovation. From our rich [Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese](https://www.noodles.com/menu/mac-cheese/creamy-cheddar-mac-cheese) dishes to globally inspired noodle bowls like [Rigatoni Rosa](https://www.noodles.com/menu/chef-curated-with-protein/rigatoni-rosa-with-parmesan-chicken) and [Japanese Pan Noodles](https://www.noodles.com/menu/culinary-classics/japanese-pan-noodles), our diverse selection ensures there’s something for everyone. No matter your mood, we have the dish to match—each made fresh, just for you.

[Discover Our Food](https://www.noodles.com/our-food)

[Explore Our Menu](https://www.noodles.com/menu)

![Image 5: Preview](blob:http://localhost/9a396c15350f04d116aba691ef21e26a)

![Image 6: Basil Pesto Cavatappi and Cherry Tomatoes](https://www.noodles.com/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/2026-07/AboutBasilPesto_0.png.webp?itok=lk5cQ2ap)

## Our Journey

From the beginning, we have committed ourselves to serving fresh food, fresh ingredients and a fresh perspective of caring for our guests, our team members and our communities. We truly believe there is nothing that can bring people together—or make the world a better place—quite like a bowl of noodles.  
  
As we continue to grow, we are taking on key initiatives across our company to support a brighter future. Our impact report delves into some of these areas, such as curating a menu filled with fresh and exciting new flavors; activating industry-leading people benefits; and exploring ways we can better care for our communities—and our planet—we call home.  
  
We’re excited and look forward to creating even more meaningful change.

![Image 7: Preview](blob:http://localhost/269537453ff1c2531410b7d43706fd22)

![Image 8: Family enjoying noodles dishes like basil pesto cavatappi, potstickers and crispy chicken bacon alfredo.](https://www.noodles.com/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/2025-03/Family%20enjoying%20noodles.png.webp?itok=bstQLY8k)

## Add some flavor to your fundraising with a Noodles Fundraiser Night.

With a Noodles Fundraiser Night, it’s easier and tastier than ever to raise funds for your organization. We have tons of experience bringing good food and a good cause together into one event with 20% of all qualifying sales going back to your nonprofit organization. It’s how we’re turning favorites into funds for your cause.

[Learn More About Fundraising](https://www.noodles.com/about-noodles/giving-back)

![Image 9: Noodles & Company customers sitting on a couch in a living room browsing the Noodles & Company website on a laptop.](https://www.noodles.com/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/2025-08/about-fundraising-image.png.webp?itok=ynHft27f)

## Animal Welfare

Noodles & Company was founded on and remains committed to providing customers with delicious freshly-cooked food made from the best ingredients. We recognize that humane animal farming practices are critical to ensuring sustained food safety and high quality, and are an important consideration for informed consumers who increasingly support brands that align with their values.

[Our Approach to Animal Welfare](https://www.noodles.com/about-noodles/animal-welfare)

## Recognition

Noodles & Company is honored to be the recipient of top awards from both the restaurant and business community.

[View All Awards](https://www.noodles.com/about-noodles/awards)

![Image 10: Forbes 2024 Best Employers for Diversity Award. Fourth year in a row. Powered by Statista.](https://www.noodles.com/sites/default/files/styles/medium/public/2024-07/forbes-2024-diversity-award.png.webp?itok=NcMT2MLE)

# It starts with a smile

Whether greeting you at the drive-thru or making your meal inside the restaurant, Chick-fil-A®Team Members strive to serve up memorable experiences for each and every guest. And we hope that dining with us inspires you to spread that sense of warmth to others, too.

![Image 39: Chick-fil-A employee smiling and interacting with two guests at an outdoor seating area.](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/04/Person-packing-compost-dirt-into-flowers-1.jpg)

![Image 40: Made with Care](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/themes/cfa/patterns/images/care-logo.svg)

Eating on the go can be a challenge, but we want to help. From hand-breading the chicken for our classic sandwiches to sourcing fresh produce for our salads and fruit cups, quality food has always been a top priority. We believe in delivering great fast food every day (except Sundays).

![Image 41: S. Truett Cathy sitting in a rocking chair outside and holding a paper](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/04/Truett-Cathy.jpg?resize=1024,683)

## Speaking of Sundays…

Our founder, S. Truett Cathy, made the decision to close on Sundays in 1946. He knew what it was like to work seven days a week in restaurants, so he saw the importance of letting his employees set aside one day to rest and worship if they choose. That’s a practice we still uphold today.

[Learn more about our company](link_31)

## Our hometown heroes, your local Operator

We choose the Owner-Operator of every CFA® restaurant with care, looking for people who want to make an impact in their communities. From hosting family events like Daddy Daughter Date Night to helping Team Members pursue higher education through the Remarkable Futures Scholarships initiative, our Operators are always looking for opportunities to give back.

[See how we support our communities](link_33)

![Image 42: A Team Member holding a Chick-fil-A bag](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/04/Hometown-Heroes.jpg?w=564)

![Image 43: A Chick-fil-A Team Member smiling.](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/04/Our-Pleasure.jpg?resize=1024,683)

## It’s our pleasure

One day when Truett was staying at a hotel, an employee responded to his thanks with a sincere “my pleasure.” The memory of that interaction, and the way it made Truett feel, stayed with him. Returning home, he encouraged his team to respond with “my pleasure” whenever a customer said thank you. It’s something we still do to this day.

[**Find your nearest CFA® restaurant**](link_34)

![Image 44](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/06/CFA_469276_Q2-Catering_Kitchen-Nuggets-Reheatable-A_US_Web_Footer_Desktop_692x637@2x.jpg)

Feed them all this fall

Planning a gathering? Let us take care of the menu. Chick-fil-A® Catering makes it easy with Nugget Trays, boxed meals, desserts and more.​

Razzoo’s Cajun Cafe brings the bold flavors of Louisiana to the table with classic Cajun food made to satisfy. From rich gumbo and hearty étouffée to blackened favorites and crispy fried staples, every dish is rooted in traditional Cajun cuisine and packed with unmistakable Southern flavor. # Cajun/Creole Restaurants in Dallas

Cajun and creole dishes are often found in many restaurants, though few eating establishments exist that serve Cajun-creole cuisine exclusively. Dallas Cajun-creole restaurants serve food that is primarily made with spices such as black pepper, cayenne, garlic, and thyme. Many restaurants also serve exotic dishes that include dove, quail, blue crab, and even alligator. Jambalaya is, of course, the standard Cajun-creole dish served at most non-cajun restaurants.

# Welcome to Chick-fil-A®

* * *

Known as much for our warm, personable service as our delicious food, Chick-fil-A has come a long way since our humble beginnings, when S. Truett Cathy opened the first Chick-fil-A Restaurant in Atlanta in 1967.

## Corporate Purpose

To glorify God by being a faithful steward of all that is entrusted to us. To have a positive influence on all who come in contact with Chick-fil-A.

## Investing in local ownership

Most Owner-Operators own only one restaurant, meaning they’re small business owners who are onsite and actively involved. They are regularly working with their Team Members and take a hands-on approach in order to foster connections within their communities. Over the past two years, 76 percent of newly selected Owner-Operators had experience working as Team Members themselves.

[Learn about becoming an Owner-Operator](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/franchise)

![Image 40: Two Team Members Smiling outside of Chick-fil-A location](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/08/Two-Team-Members-Smiling-outside-of-Chick-fil-A-location.jpg?w=636)

![Image 41: Five Team Members standing together outside of a Chick-fil-A Restaurant](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/06/Investing-in-our-Teams.jpg?w=636)

## Caring for Team Members

Chick-fil-A restaurants aim to add a positive impact beyond profit, including giving back to local communities and advancing opportunities for others. By investing in Team Members through our[scholarship program](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/remarkable-futures-scholarships), leadership development, access to well-being benefits and more, Owner-Operators can know their Team Members are taken care of and will, in turn, take care of our customers.

[Learn more about Team Member Scholarships](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/remarkable-futures-scholarships)

## Community Impact: Addressing local hunger

Through the Chick-fil-A Shared Table®program, local Chick-fil-A Owner-Operators fight food insecurity in their neighborhoods by donating surplus food from their restaurants to local soup kitchens, shelters and nonprofits to feed those in need. To date, more than 30 million meals have been created from Chick-fil-A Shared Table®donations from over 2,200 participating Chick-fil-A restaurants throughout the U.S. and Canada.   
  
Additionally, every time a new Chick-fil-A restaurant opens, Chick-fil-A, Inc. donates $25,000 to Feeding America or Second Harvest in Canada to support local hunger relief efforts.

[Learn more about the Chick-fil-A Shared Table program](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/shared-table)

![Image 42: A Team Member smiling and handing a Customer an insulated Chick-fil-A bag](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/06/shared-table-canada-module_11zon-1.jpg?resize=1024,677)

![Image 43: A Team Member standing outside a Chick-fil-A Restaurant smiling and holding a drink carrier](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/06/Working-at-CFA.jpg?w=636)

## Working at Chick-fil-A

We believe a strong and caring culture is essential to our success. The notion of care applies not only to our local Owner-Operators, Team Members and Guests in Chick-fil-A restaurants but also to how we treat each other at the offices of our Support Center in Atlanta.

Chick-fil-A is committed to a workplace culture where everyone is treated with honor, dignity and respect. “We are better together” – one of our core values – means that when we combine our unique backgrounds and experiences with a culture of belonging we can strengthen the quality of care we deliver.

[Work with us](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/careers)

## Innovative from the beginning

Chick-fil-A was the first restaurant to pair shopping and eating by opening in an Atlanta-area mall. We continue to look for new ways to meet our customers where they are, with digital enhancements and bold new restaurant designs. As the first quick-service restaurant to introduce parent-friendly menus, with fruit cups and a grilled entree, we believe we can always find newer and better ways to care for our customers.

[Explore innovation in action](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/press-room/reimagining-hospitality-in-a-digital-world)

![Image 44: A rendering of a modern Chick-fil-A Restaurant with an elevated Drive-Thru](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/06/Innovative-from-the-beginning.jpg?w=636)

![Image 45: The Cathy family standing in a row outside](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/06/cathy_family20224811zon.jpg)

## A people business and a family business

Truett always maintained he was in the people business, prioritizing customer service and dedication to his community. When traveling one day, he thanked the employee of a high-end hotel and the man responded, “my pleasure.” Struck by that response, Truett encouraged his employees to add that phrase to their daily interactions, something they do to this day.  
  
Chick-fil-A is still a family business, with Truett’s grandson, Andrew, serving as the CEO. The Cathy family has been working together for over 70 years. Today, several second and third generation Cathy family members carry on the company tradition.

![Image 46: Overhead view of a table with people eating salads](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/05/together11500x800jpgcfawebready_jpg.jpg)

## Commitment to quality

Our Restaurants offer top-quality food, served with exceptional hospitality. Whether it’s offering more wholesome options or simply removing unnecessary ingredients, we believe in food we can feel good about. Striving to serve freshly prepared food while reducing food waste, we take a “cook less, more often” approach. By studying smart, lean manufacturing principles used in other industries, we’re working toward a menu that achieves these goals and enhances your experience, while never sacrificing delicious taste.

[What sets our food apart](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/about/great-food)

## A growing tradition

A lot has changed over the years, from delicious new menu items to our popular Chick-fil-A®App that makes ordering quick and easy. But we’ve never changed our commitment to warm, friendly service – or the recipe for our Chick-fil-A®Chicken Sandwich, which Truett perfected at The Dwarf House®restaurant, previously known as The Dwarf Grill, a restaurant he opened with his brother, Ben, in 1946.  
  
Our dedication to service is what has put Chick-fil-A on the path toward strong success. With locations in 48 states and counting as well as[Puerto Rico](https://www.chick-fil-a.pr/), [Canada](https://www.chick-fil-a.ca/), the [United Kingdom](https://www.chick-fil-a.co.uk/), and [Singapore](https://www.chick-fil-a.com.sg/), we are excited about joining new communities and expanding internationally.

[See where we’re going next](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/press-room)

![Image 47: Two customers smiling holding shakes](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/06/Caring-for-our-communities.jpg?w=636)

![Image 48](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/06/CFA_469276_Q2-Catering_Kitchen-Nuggets-Reheatable-A_US_Web_Footer_Desktop_692x637@2x.jpg)

Feed them all this fall

## Chick-fil-A® Catering​

Planning a gathering? Let us take care of the menu. Chick-fil-A® Catering makes it easy with Nugget Trays, boxed meals, desserts and more.​

# Chick-fil-A Nugget Nachos

 time:  30-45 MIN 

 difficulty:  Easy 

 serves:  Feeds 10 

![Image 39: A plate of nachos with cheese, chicken, and various toppings surrounded by small bowls of condiments.](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/07/Retouched-Nugget-Nacho_11zon.jpeg?w=1280)

## Ingredients

Small Chilled Chick-fil-A Nugget Tray

[Order now](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/catering/catering-trays/chilled-chick-fil-a-nugget-trays)

12 ounces shredded cheese

2 cups romaine lettuce

One 8-ounce package fried or baked tostada shells

1 cup pico de gallo

1 cup guacamole

½ cup sour cream

**Optional:**

Pickled jalapeños

Sliced radish

Cilantro leaves

## Steps

[Copy Full Recipe](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/stories/recipes/chick-fil-a-nugget-nachos#)

### Reheating Chick-fil-A Nuggets

1.   Preheat the oven to 325°F.
2.   Transfer Chick-fil-A Nuggets from aluminum pan to one or more cookie sheets and separate individual pieces so they are not touching. (Do not use foil aluminum pan to reheat Chick-fil-A Nuggets.)
3.   Place cookie sheet(s) into the oven and cook for 15-20 minutes or until Chick-fil-A Nuggets hold an internal temperature of at least 165°F for at least 15 seconds

### Preparing Chick-fil-A Nuggets Nachos

1.   Preheat the oven to 425°F.
2.   Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
3.   Open the tostada shell package, and gently break each tostada shell in half. Arrange on baking sheets in a single layer.
4.   Carefully slice cooked Chick-fil-A Nuggets into thirds. Top tostada shells with cheese and Chick-fil-A Nuggets. Place cookie sheets into oven and bake for 5 minutes.
5.   Remove cookie sheets. Carefully remove the tostadas from the hot baking sheet and arrange in a single layer on a serving platter.
6.   Place romaine lettuce in the middle of the platter. Add pico de gallo, sour cream, and guacamole on top of the lettuce.
7.   (Optional) Top with pickled jalapeños, radish and cilantro leaves

# Chick-fil-A Chicken Pot Pie

 time:  30-45 MIN 

 difficulty:  Medium 

 serves:  6 

![Image 39: Two ramekins of chick pot pie with biscuits, a glass of iced tea, and utensils on a tabletop.](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/07/chicken-pot-pie_11zon.jpg?w=1113)

## Ingredients

**10-count Chick-fil-A Chick-n-Strips, sliced**

[Order now](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/menu/chick-fil-a-chick-n-strips)

3 Chick-fil-A Buttery Biscuits, warmed

2 ½ cups reduced-sodium chicken broth

15 oz can of mixed vegetables, drained

¼ tsp ground sage

¼ tsp garlic powder

2 tbsp corn starch

4 tbsp cold water

Ground black pepper

**Substitutions**

4 Grilled Chick-fil-A Chicken filets

3 southern-style or buttermilk biscuits, warmed

## Steps

[Copy Full Recipe](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/stories/recipes/chicken-pot-pie#)

1.   Combine diced chicken and broth in a medium sauce pan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and keep at a simmer.
2.   Stir in canned vegetables, ground sage and garlic powder. Let cook for 20 minutes.
3.   In a small bowl, mix corn starch and water. Pour into hot stew and stir. Let cook 3 minutes longer or until thickened.
4.   Portion stew into bowls. Season with ground black pepper and top with a half biscuit.

# Projects

![Image 2](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/FirstMidwest.jpg)

![Image 3: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

First Midwest Bank Columbia, MO

Representing the seller, Maly helped broker a high-visibility location at 1215 Fellows Place for First Midwest Bank, allowing the financial institution to open its first location in Columbia, Missouri.

![Image 4](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/StoneyCreek.jpg)

![Image 5: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

Stoney Creek Inn Columbia, MO

Maly brokered an ideal site at South Providence Road for national hotel operator Stoney Creek Hotel & Conference Center. Stoney Creek hosts business and leisure travelers who enjoy the convenient location near the University of Missouri, “The District” and the Katy Trail.

![Image 6](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/Lowes.jpg)

![Image 7: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

Lowe’s Nationwide

Maly developed 125 Lowe’s sites throughout the United States over a 10 period. Like every commercial project, each was different. Some stores created an entirely new multi-tenant retail center and required complete re-zoning efforts, while others were placed in existing centers.

![Image 8](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/Neidermeyer.jpg)

![Image 9: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

The Niedermeyer Building Columbia, MO

Maly was instrumental in the preservation of the Niedermeyer—the oldest building in Columbia. Under contract to be bulldozed, we helped find a buyer willing to keep the building standing while helping the original party find an alternative site—a win for both parties and the community.

![Image 10](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/Grindstone.jpg)

![Image 11: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

Grindstone Plaza Columbia, MO

Development of this retail center required two years of re-zoning efforts and a coordinated response to neighborhood opposition and public hearings aimed at preventing the project. Anchored by a Walmart Supercenter, the location offers high visibility and traffic on Columbia’s south side. **[Land for lease](link_5)** and[**retail opportunities available.**](link_6)

![Image 12](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/Fairview-Mktplace.jpg)

![Image 13: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

Fairview Marketplace Columbia, MO

Maly developed this site in west Columbia after five years of contentious re-zoning efforts. Opposition included vandalism and angry neighbors who placed thousands of yard signs throughout Columbia in protest. Anchored by a Walmart Supercenter, the retail center has spurred dramatic growth in the area.[**Leasing opportunities available.**](link_7)

![Image 14](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/Panera.jpg)

![Image 15: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

Providence South Center COLUMBIA, MO

Maly Commercial Realty negotiated with Bank of America to acquire the adjacent land next to their bank location at Providence and Nifong in South Columbia. After acquisition, we resolved several site and drainage issues to develop this property featuring a Panera Bread and Sherwin-Williams Paint store.

# Projects

![Image 2](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/FirstMidwest.jpg)

![Image 3: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

First Midwest Bank Columbia, MO

Representing the seller, Maly helped broker a high-visibility location at 1215 Fellows Place for First Midwest Bank, allowing the financial institution to open its first location in Columbia, Missouri.

![Image 4](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/StoneyCreek.jpg)

![Image 5: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

Stoney Creek Inn Columbia, MO

Maly brokered an ideal site at South Providence Road for national hotel operator Stoney Creek Hotel & Conference Center. Stoney Creek hosts business and leisure travelers who enjoy the convenient location near the University of Missouri, “The District” and the Katy Trail.

![Image 6](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/Lowes.jpg)

![Image 7: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

Lowe’s Nationwide

Maly developed 125 Lowe’s sites throughout the United States over a 10 period. Like every commercial project, each was different. Some stores created an entirely new multi-tenant retail center and required complete re-zoning efforts, while others were placed in existing centers.

![Image 8](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/Neidermeyer.jpg)

![Image 9: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

The Niedermeyer Building Columbia, MO

Maly was instrumental in the preservation of the Niedermeyer—the oldest building in Columbia. Under contract to be bulldozed, we helped find a buyer willing to keep the building standing while helping the original party find an alternative site—a win for both parties and the community.

![Image 10](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/Grindstone.jpg)

![Image 11: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

Grindstone Plaza Columbia, MO

Development of this retail center required two years of re-zoning efforts and a coordinated response to neighborhood opposition and public hearings aimed at preventing the project. Anchored by a Walmart Supercenter, the location offers high visibility and traffic on Columbia’s south side. **[Land for lease](https://maly-dev.wearewoodruff.xyz/property/grindstone-plaza-6-acres/)** and[**retail opportunities available.**](https://maly-dev.wearewoodruff.xyz/property/grindstone-plaza-2/)

![Image 12](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/Fairview-Mktplace.jpg)

![Image 13: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

Fairview Marketplace Columbia, MO

Maly developed this site in west Columbia after five years of contentious re-zoning efforts. Opposition included vandalism and angry neighbors who placed thousands of yard signs throughout Columbia in protest. Anchored by a Walmart Supercenter, the retail center has spurred dramatic growth in the area.[**Leasing opportunities available.**](https://maly-dev.wearewoodruff.xyz/property/fairview-marketplace-2/)

![Image 14](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/Panera.jpg)

![Image 15: Below Shadow](https://malyrealty.com/wp-content/themes/maly/images/belowshadownew.png)

Providence South Center COLUMBIA, MO

Maly Commercial Realty negotiated with Bank of America to acquire the adjacent land next to their bank location at Providence and Nifong in South Columbia. After acquisition, we resolved several site and drainage issues to develop this property featuring a Panera Bread and Sherwin-Williams Paint store.

## Neighborhood Favorites at Applebee's Columbia

Applebee’s is an American restaurant and bar and grill in Columbia, near the corner of Trimble Road & East Broadway. This Boone County restaurant sits in an area known for Mid-Missouri university town, making it the perfect family-friendly place to eat for lunch, late-night dining, watch the game, or find [happy hour](link_20) or [lunch specials in Columbia](link_21). If dining in is not on the menu, this restaurant proudly offers restaurant [delivery](link_18), [takeout](link_17), and [catering](link_19).

Whether grabbing dinner with friends, enjoying a family meal, or ordering takeout and delivery, you’ll love our delicious steaks, mouthwatering [burgers](link_22), shareable appetizers, and famous [boneless wings](link_23) tossed in signature sauces. Returning from an evening flight from COU airport? Applebee’s is open late just for you, with friendly bartenders ready to pour your favorite drink in a 16-oz glass or our special 20-oz Brewtus.

[Start Order](link_15)

## Get to Know This Applebee's on East Broadway

Applebee’s in Columbia opened its doors on June 27, 2005. Experience what makes it a go-to destination for burgers, steaks, appetizers, and boneless wings, all available for takeout and delivery in Columbia.

Our guests include military veterans, some of whom served at the nearby Ike Skelton Training Site. If you are a veteran or active-duty service member, we invite you to join us and take part in our annual [Veterans Day free meal offer](link_24). We also welcome Columbia City Hall and Hillcrest Community Center employees, along with those visiting after a day at U.S. Small Business Administration - Columbia, MO.

## Tips for New Visitors to Applebee's Columbia

Check the weather before you come to eat with us. In Columbia, we get as many as 41 inches of rain annually and average temperatures around 12.6°C/54.7°F. Summer highs are near 32.0°C/89.6°F, and winter lows are around -6.9°C/19.6°F. Dress accordingly!

### Need An Excuse to Go Out to Eat?

Need some excuses to get out today? Head out for a picnic at Clyde Wilson Memorial Park, C.M. Albert Memorial Park, or Stephens Lake Park with our [Fiesta Lime Chicken](link_39) or [Salads](link_32) to-go. Students from University of Missouri, Stephens College, and Columbia College make us their favorite study-break spot, while shoppers at Lowry Mall appreciate our convenient location.

Local events such as Art in the Park and Roots N Blues N BBQ Festival bring the community together, and fans of Missouri Tigers and Kansas City Chiefs gather here before heading to the big game at Silverthorne Arena and other popular arenas. # Frequently Asked Questions

  
  

Thanks for being a part of the Neighborhood! If you don't see the answer to your question below, feel free to [contact us here.](https://www.applebees.com/en/contact-us)

### W-2 Questions

If you are a franchisee restaurant Team Member with questions regarding your W-2, please call your franchise main number or home office for assistance.

### Veterans Day FAQs

#### How can I receive my free entree on Veterans Day?

Thank you for your service! To enjoy your complimentary entrée on Veterans Day, simply stop by your local Applebee’s® and show proof of military service, such as a U.S. Uniform Services Identification Card, DDT214 Citation or Commendation, your U.S. Uniform Services Retired Identification Card, a Current Leave and Earnings Statement (LES) or your Veterans Organization Card (e.g. American Legion and VFW). Alternatively, you can provide a photograph of yourself in your military uniform.

### General FAQs

#### How can I sign up for Applebee's® emails?

Looking for the scoop on exclusive deals, specials, and more? Click [here](https://www.applebees.com/en/sign-up) to learn more about [Club Applebee's®](https://www.applebees.com/en/sign-up) and sign up today!

#### Can I order food items by phone?

Yes! Applebee’s is available To Go via phone (for pickup only), on our website, the Applebee’s Mobile App and through various third-party delivery providers. At participating locations, Applebee's offers [Carside To Go®](https://www.applebees.com/en/order/startyourorder)app service for phone orders, which include designated Carside To Go parking spaces for you to wait in while a Team Member brings you your order. Select locations nationwide also offer a drive thru pickup window for added convenience for orders placed online.

#### Are recipes available for the items on your menu?

We appreciate the interest in our mouthwatering menu items, but due to proprietary and confidential reasons, recipes are not available for any menu items.

#### How can I own and operate an Applebee's restaurant?

Applebee’s Grill + Bar is seeking qualified candidates to develop restaurants in new and existing markets to grow both traditional and non-traditional sectors. To learn more about franchising opportunities with Applebee's, visit our [domestic franchising website.](https://franchise.applebees.com/en/us/request-more-info)

If you're interested in franchising opportunities outside of the United States, please visit our [international franchising website](https://franchise.applebees.com/en/international) for more information.

#### Can I buy stock in Applebee's?

Dine Brands Global, Inc. is the parent company of Applebee’s, IHOP, and Fuzzy’s Taco Shop. Dine Brands is one of the largest publicly traded restaurant companies in the world (on the NYSE under the symbol DIN).

#### Would Applebee's® be interested in raising funds for my cause or charity?

At Applebee’s, we’re committed to Doin’ Good in the Neighborhood and giving back to local communities. We recommend you contact your neighborhood Applebee’s restaurant and ask to speak to a manager. As we are 100 percent franchised, vetting fundraising requests may vary locally. For address information, please use our[restaurant locator](https://www.applebees.com/locations).

#### Would Applebee's® be interested in sponsoring my event?

All opportunities for national sponsorships, sales, direct marketing, advertising, media and merchandising should be emailed to [Marketing@Applebees.com](mailto:Marketing@Applebees.com). All proposals are reviewed and responded to within 5-10 business days. If you have a request for a local or regional sponsorship, please contact the manager of your local restaurant.

#### I'm a student working on a school project. Can I find out more about how your company works?

Due to the volume of student requests that we receive, we are currently unable to grant interview requests or provide detailed information about our corporate strategies, marketing programs, or internal systems and processes. However, we recommend you check out our newsroom on Applebees.com and our annual reports or SEC filings, available online at DineBrands.com. Please visit our Investor Relations website to access these documents.

#### Who do I contact if I had a positive or poor guest experience at an Applebee's restaurant?

We love hearing from our guests and value all feedback. Tell us about your experience through our [contact us](https://www.applebees.com/en/contact-us) form or via email at [guest.relations@applebees.com.](mailto:guest.relations@applebees.com)

#### Who do I contact if I'm a member of the media and have an inquiry regarding Applebee's?

Media inquiries can be sent via email to[MediaRelations@Applebees.com](mailto:MediaRelations@Applebees.com).

#### Who do I contact if I'm a financial analyst and need information regarding the company?

Analyst inquiries should be directed to [ir@dinebrands.com.](mailto:ir@dinebrands.com).

#### What animal health and welfare standards does Applebee's have in place?

For information about Animal Health and Welfare and Applebee’s Business Responsibility initiatives, please visit our [parent company website](https://www.dinebrands.com/en/business-responsibility).

### Gift Card FAQ

#### How do I buy a Gift Card to use today?

We offer 2 convenient ways to purchase a gift card today. Visit our [Gift Cards](https://www.applebees.com/gift-cards/holiday-deal) page.

Gift Cards may be purchased at any Applebee's Neighborhood Grill & Bar location for any amount between $5.00 and $500.00. If you have time for your Gift Card to be mailed to you, please use our secure online ordering system.

Digital Gift Cards may be purchased directly from our website. Simply fill out the information requested and send to any email address. Get your [Digital Gift Card](https://www.applebees.com/gift-cards/holiday-deal) now.

#### Can I use a gift card to purchase a gift card?

Applebee's gift cards are not redeemable for Applebee's gift cards.

#### Can I mail a Gift Card to another person?

Gift Card orders under $200 can be shipped to any United States address. Cards shipped via UPS cannot be delivered to a P.O. Box address.

#### How long will it take to get my Gift Card?

Gift Card orders for physical cards that are received from our website will process & ship the following business day. There are several shipping options for your convenience ranging from standard mail to overnight delivery.

Digital Gift Cards can be processed and printed immediately.

Get your [Digital Gift Card](https://www.applebees.com/gift-cards/holiday-deal) now.

#### Can I print a Gift Card for immediate use?

Absolutely. Our Digital Gift Cards make it easy to order and print immediately. Follow our order process and send your Digital Gift Card to any email address. Once you receive our email message, print out the Digital Gift Card and take into any Applebee's Neighborhood Grill & Bar to redeem. Get your [Digital Gift Card](https://www.applebees.com/gift-cards/holiday-deal) now.

#### Can Gift Cards be purchased over the phone?

No, for your security we do not accept orders over the phone. Cards may be purchased via our secure website or any Applebee's Neighborhood Grill & Bar.

#### Do Gift Cards ever expire or decline in value?

Applebee's Gift Cards never expire and they do not decrease in value.

#### Can I reload or add to an existing Gift Card?

Unfortunately, Applebee's Gift Cards cannot be reloaded. But we will be happy to sell you another one.

#### What should I do if I lose my Gift Card?

Always protect your Gift Card as if it were cash. In the event that you do lose your card, call us at **1-800-252-6722**. Please have your card number or the receipt available when calling.

#### I live outside the United States. Can I order a Gift Card online?

For your convenience, we offer Digital Gift Cards that you can order and print online. Simply follow our order process to print your Digital Gift Card now.

If you'd prefer a Physical Gift Card, please contact [gift.cards@applebees.com](mailto:gift.cards@applebees.com). We have a customer order form that can be completed for your purchase. Please note that Gift Cards purchased in either the U.S. or Canada are accepted in both countries. Cross-acceptance and cross-currency redemption is only possible between the U.S. and Canada at this time.

#### GIFT CARD FRAUD

#### How to Avoid and Report Fraudulent and Suspicious Gift Card Activity

*   Applebee’s Gift Cards are available for purchase in-restaurant, on applebees.com , and at other various retailers.
*   Applebee’s has many partners distributing digital and plastic gift cards.
*   Applebee’s Gift Cards are only applicable and eligible for purchases at Applebee’s Restaurants, applebees.com, or the Applebee’s mobile app in the U.S. only. Other businesses do not accept payments in the form of Applebee’s Gift Cards. 
*   Do not purchase an Applebee’s Gift Card if the packaging appears manipulated, ripped, altered, or if the PIN has been scratched off. If you notice anything suspicious about the packaging of an Applebee’s Gift Card, bring it up with the store management.
*   Do not divulge your Applebee’s Gift Card number or PIN to anyone. 
*   Be wary of callers and scammers who try to impersonate a legitimate company or a government entity. Some common gift card scams are: 
    *   **IRS Scam**– scammers will call, claiming to be an IRS agent and saying that you owe money or you will be arrested, instructing you to purchase gift cards and give them the gift card numbers.
    *   **Grandparent Scam** – scammers will call, claiming that their loved one is in trouble and they need help, instructing you to purchase gift cards and give them the gift card numbers.
    *   **Mystery Shopper Scam** – scammers will send a check and letter, asking you to participate as a “mystery shopper” by cashing the check, purchasing goods and gift cards at the targeted store, and sending it back to them. The fake check bounces after sending the goods and gift cards to the scammers. 

*    Applebee’s Gift Cards can only be used at Applebee’s Restaurants, applebees.com, or the Applebee’s mobile app in the U.S. only. Legitimate government entities such as IRS, Treasury Department, FBI or local police departments do not accept any form of Applebee’s Gift Cards as payment. 
*   Legitimate businesses other than Applebee’s do not accept payments in the form of Applebee’s Gift Cards. For instance, you will never be asked to pay your utility bills, bail money, debt collection and hospital bills with Applebee’s Gift Cards.
*   If you get a call from a stranger who says that a loved one is in trouble and they ask you to provide Applebee’s Gift Card numbers to help them, we recommend you hang up and contact your loved one directly.

*   Applebee’s Gift Cards are not free. Be mindful on clicking and responding to ads and websites that offer free or discounted Gift Cards. These are scams.
*   If you think you or your family member has become a victim of a gift card scam, report it to the Federal Trade Commission at[reportfraud.ftc.gov/assistant](https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/assistant).

#### I received a chain email offering me a free Applebee's Gift Card. Is it real or is it a scam?

Recently there have been scams involving Applebee's Gift Cards. If you see something that is too good to be true on the web or receive a chain email offering you a free Applebee's Gift Card or gift certificate, it's probably a scam.

You can buy Applebee's Gift Cards at any of our over 1500 restaurant locations nationwide, at a variety of traditional retailers, through select rewards programs, and on our secure website.

#### I received an email that said I should forward the message to receive free Applebee's® Gift Certificates. Is it for real?

No. A fraudulent email chain message promising Applebee's® Gift Certificates for forwarding the message is currently making its way around the Internet. The message promises a gift certificate and a confirmation number after forwarding the message to a specific number of email addresses. Applebee's® International, Inc. does not sponsor or endorse this activity and is unable to fulfill these requests.

#### I have responded to an Internet pop-up advertisement that promised a free Applebee's® Gift Card but I haven't received it. What can I do?

Applebee's® does occasionally endorse providers of various online offers, such as credit cards, book clubs, and financial lenders, and allows them to offer free Applebee's Gift Cards. However, all inquiries about your free Applebee's® Gift Cards should be directed to the organization that made the offer. We have no way of tracking your information, since such transactions take place between you and a particular vendor, not Applebee's.

#### Additional resources

#### Internal Revenue Service (IRS)

*   Tax Scams: [https://www.irs.gov/uac/tax-scams-consumer-alerts](https://www.irs.gov/uac/tax-scams-consumer-alerts)
*   Reporting Scams: [https://www.treasury.gov/tigta/contact_report_scam.shtml](https://www.treasury.gov/tigta/contact_report_scam.shtml) or call 800-366-4484

*   Scam Alerts: [https://www.consumer.ftc.gov/scam-alerts](https://www.consumer.ftc.gov/scam-alerts)

# FIND AN APPLEBEE'S RESTAURANT THAT DELIVERS NEAR YOU

## Tired Of Going Out? Try Our Restaurant Delivery Near You

![Image 5](https://www.applebees.com/-/media/applebees2/images/marketing-components/icons/comfortable-environment.svg?rev=3d86e81586db43b689fecbf6a2b50e0c)

![Image 6: Icon of an Applebee's Restaurant](https://www.applebees.com/-/media/applebees2/images/marketing-components/icons/stability-flexibility.svg?rev=8b9896cd935c43c28c57c8b3a0393f06)

![Image 7: Icon of an Applebee's To Go bag](https://www.applebees.com/-/media/applebees2/images/marketing-components/icons/catering-packaging.png?rev=9010295527c84367bf97202bb638e028)

[Order Delivery Now](https://www.applebees.com/en/order/startyourorder)

![Image 8: Image of Applebee's® Delivery](https://www.applebees.com/-/media/applebees2/images/delivery-page/delivery-landing-page-white-feature-tile-desktop.jpg?rev=13b7237a89214b00b8e8b7e81c480b08)

 Applebee's Delivery Options For Any Occasion 

Applebee's delivery service is your all-in-one solution, whether planning a party, ordering office lunches, or seeking a cozy dinner for two. From game days to birthdays or everyday meals, our online ordering and swift delivery ensure you can savor Applebee's favorites like Crispy Chicken Tender Salad, Boneless Wings, Grill Burgers, Fiesta Lime Chicken, and more for any occasion.

[Explore Menu](https://www.applebees.com/en/menu "Applebee's Delivery Options For Any Occasion")

### Local Flavors Delivered - Easy Online Ordering

The neighborhood flavors you love, delivered right to your door! Our online menu makes ordering entrees like our ribs, steak, chicken, seafood and bowls easy. Skip grocery shopping and enjoy your favorite dishes from home! Build a custom meal with our signature appetizers, salads, entrees, and desserts using our convenient online ordering system. Bring the restaurant flavors you crave straight from our kitchen to your home in no time with our speedy and convenient online ordering.

[Find Your Applebee's Opens in new tab](https://restaurants.applebees.com/en-us/ "Find Your Applebee's ")

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

### Is There A Minimum Order Requirement For Food Delivery?

 There is no minimum for delivery - order as much or as little as you want, and we’ll deliver it right to you. Get a meal for yourself or a whole spread to share - either way, your made-to-order meal will arrive piping hot and ready to enjoy! 

### What Are The Delivery Hours For Applebee’s?

Delivery hours may vary depending on location. To find out more, call your local restaurant and see when you can get signature dishes delivered to your door.

### Is The Full Menu Available For Delivery?

 Applebee’s offers our entire signature food menu for delivery. If you love it on our menu, you can have it delivered! 

### Can I Schedule A Delivery For A Specific Time?

Yes! You can schedule your Applebee’s delivery in advance for the time that works best for you. Simply place your online order, customize your meal details, and select your preferred delivery date and time.

Delivery may not be available in all locations. Price and participation vary by location. Select items available for a limited time only and while supplies last. © 2026 Applebee's Restaurants LLC.

Plates, serving utensils, and cutlery are all included in your catering order.

## Tips for New Visitors to Applebee's Columbia

Check the weather before you come to eat with us. In Columbia, we get as many as 41 inches of rain annually and average temperatures around 12.6°C/54.7°F. Summer highs are near 32.0°C/89.6°F, and winter lows are around -6.9°C/19.6°F. Dress accordingly!

### Need An Excuse to Go Out to Eat?

Need some excuses to get out today? Head out for a picnic at Clyde Wilson Memorial Park, C.M. Albert Memorial Park, or Stephens Lake Park with our [Fiesta Lime Chicken](https://www.applebees.com/en/menu/chicken/fiesta-lime-chicken) or [Salads](https://www.applebees.com/en/menu/salads) to-go. Or, after a hot day near Stephens Lake or Missouri River, stop in for an [Applewood-smoked burger](https://www.applebees.com/en/menu/handcrafted-burgers/whole-lotta-bacon-burger) and a cold draft beer.

Culture lovers touring Davis Art Gallery or seeing a performance at Missouri Theatre can cap the day with one of our signature cocktails at the bar. Students from University of Missouri, Stephens College, and Columbia College make us their favorite study-break spot, while shoppers at Lowry Mall appreciate our convenient location.

Local events such as Art in the Park and Roots N Blues N BBQ Festival bring the community together, and fans of Missouri Tigers and Kansas City Chiefs gather here before heading to the big game at Silverthorne Arena and other popular arenas. If you decide to leave your car at home, the nearest bus stop is at the Tiger Line 402 stop.

### Columbia Essential Services

Essential services like Boone County Fire District Station 12 and Columbia Police Department are only blocks away, and you’ll find neighbors from Pierpont, McBaine, Ashland, and Huntsdale just down the road.

**Applebee's Restaurants LLC.** is an American company that develops, franchises, and operates the **Applebee's Neighborhood Grill + Bar**[restaurant chain](link_30). Applebee's focuses on [casual dining](link_10), with mainstream American dishes such as salads, chicken, burgers, and "[riblets](link_31)" (Applebee's signature dish).

## History

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Applebee%27s&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: History")]

### 1980–2006: Founding and going public

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Applebee%27s&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: 1980–2006: Founding and going public")]

The Applebee's chain was founded by Bill and T. J. Palmer in July 1980. Their vision was "to create a restaurant that had a neighborhood pub feel to it and could offer friendly service along with quality fare at a lower price than most of their competition." The name “Appleby” was their first choice for this concept, but they found that it had already been registered.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-5) They also considered "Cinnamon's" and "Pepper's" before arriving at Applebee's.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-6) They opened their first location on November 19, 1980, in [Decatur, Georgia](link_32), at the time named T.J. Applebee's Rx for Edibles & Elixirs.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-:2-7) They opened a second location outside of [Atlanta](link_11), Georgia, a few years later, and sold the company to [W. R. Grace and Company](link_33) in May 1983.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-DMMD-8) As part of the transaction, Bill Palmer was named president of the Applebee's Division, an indirect subsidiary of W. R. Grace and Company. In that capacity, Palmer guided the operation from its entrepreneurial beginnings to a full-fledged franchise system. He became an Applebee's franchisee in 1985. Bill Palmer died in 2020.

In 1986, the name of the concept was changed to Applebee's Neighborhood Grill & Bar.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-9) In 1988, Applebee's International, Inc., became the restaurant chain's franchiser when Kansas City franchisees Abe Gustin and John Hamra purchased the rights to the Applebee's concept from W. R. Grace.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-10) In 1989, Applebee's opened their 100th restaurant in Nashville, Tennessee.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-:2-7)

In the 1990s, Applebee's became one of the largest sit-down restaurant chains in the United States,[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-ShiftingScene-11) and it began [trading publicly](link_34) in November 1991.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-12) In 1998, Applebee's opened its 1000th restaurant.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-:2-7)

### 2007–present: Acquisition by IHOP

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Applebee%27s&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: 2007–present: Acquisition by IHOP")]

[![Image 8](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/4b/Applebees-lenexa.jpg/250px-Applebees-lenexa.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Applebees-lenexa.jpg)

Former headquarters in [Lenexa, Kansas](link_35) (now called Restaurant Support Center)

On July 16, 2007, [IHOP Corp.](link_28) announced that it agreed to buy Applebee's International for about $2.1 billion. Applebee's shareholders would receive $25.50 in cash per share, representing a 4.6% premium to the closing price on July 13, 2007.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-Applebee's-Dec-2007-8-K-13)[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-15)

The acquisition was completed on November 29, 2007,[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-Applebee's-Dec-2007-8-K-13)[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-Acquisition-16) after which IHOP Corp. was renamed [Dine Equity](link_28).[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-17)[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-18) The combined company became the largest full-service restaurant company in the world, with more than 3,250 locations.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-Acquisition-16)[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-19) A major goal for the new ownership was to revitalize the chain, as well as shift towards a franchise model for the majority of its locations.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Applebee [link_0]'s#cite_note-20)

# Applebee’s in Times Square Evicted After Owing $7M

 Oct  20  2022 

 Feature 

![Image 25: An Applebee's Sign In New York City's Times Square](https://www.fsrmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Applebees-1.jpg)

 Shutterstock 

Share:

[Tweet](link_43)[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://www.fsrmagazine.com/feature/applebees-times-square-evicted-after-owing-7m/&display=popup&ref=plugin&src=share_button "Share on Facebook")[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https://www.fsrmagazine.com/feature/applebees-times-square-evicted-after-owing-7m/ "Share on LinkedIn")[Email](mailto:?subject=Your%20friend%20has%20shared%20an%20article%20with%20you.&body=Applebee%E2%80%99s%20in%20Times%20Square%20Evicted%20After%20Owing%20%247M%0D%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fwww.fsrmagazine.com%2Ffeature%2Fapplebees-times-square-evicted-after-owing-7m%2F%0D%0A "Share via Email")

Missed rent payments dating back to 2019 led to an eviction notice for the franchisee.

On Monday, a New York Supreme Court judge issued an eviction notice to the Applebee’s in Times Square, along with orders to pay about $7 million in back rent.

Though blaming COVID-19 has become a popular excuse for all business woes since 2020, the restaurant—owned by franchisee Apple Metro—started missing rent payments in June 2019 due to cash flow issues, according to court records.

The 11,000-square-foot restaurant began leasing the prominent location at 234 W. 42nd St. in 1999, and currently employs about 80 people. Last November, Apple Metro was hit with a lease termination by landlord Madison International Realty after failing to catch up on back rent.

Apple Metro began racking up the majority of its overdue balance when New York shuttered dining rooms during the pandemic. The franchisee filed a hardship declaration, claiming it was struggling to make ends meet due to those restrictions.

Although Apple Metro co-founder Roy Raeburn was able to reopen his dining room in June 2021, sales were still down 23 percent compared to the same 10-month period prior to the pandemic, according to an affidavit filed in April. Raeburn added that his business was hurt when the attached Hilton Times Square hotel, which garnered a consistent flow of customers for the restaurant, permanently shuttered its doors in September 2020.

Apple Metro sought to stay in the location and hoped to reach an agreement with Madison International Realty, but the landlord demanded it pay the overdue balance in full, said Peter Sartorius, who served as the franchisee’s attorney. Sartorius suggested that Apple Metro did not have the ability to “write a check tomorrow, frankly,” according to a court transcript.

Deborah Riegel of Rosenberg & Estis, who served as the landlord’s attorney, noted an eviction would allow another tenant to fill the space who would be in a better position to pay the asking rent.

While office towers in Times Square sat largely empty during the pandemic and tourism waned to a dribble, investors and developers see entertainment venues as the ticket back to success. In mid-April, weekly Broadway show attendance reached nearly 90 percent of pre-pandmic levels, according to trade association Broadway League.

The Planet Hollywood in Times Square, a global chain of glitzy, Hollywood-themed restaurants, permanently closed in 2020 due to high rent and property taxes. But owner Robert Earl found a cheaper space at 140 W. 42nd St. and plans to open a new Planet Hollywood, which will be housed alongside several other restaurants in the 17,500-square-foot space—including celebrity chef Guy Fieri’s concept, Chicken Guy.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Name that a business trades under for commercial purposes

This article is about businesses. For cultivated land plants, see [Cultivar §Trade designations and selling names](link_3). For pharmaceuticals, see [Drug nomenclature §Trade names](link_4). For other products and services, see [Brand name](link_5).

"D/b/a" redirects here. For other uses, see [DBA (disambiguation)](link_6).

A **trade name**, also known as a **trading name**, **business name** or **operating name**, is a [pseudonym](link_7) used by companies and other organizations that do not operate under their registered legal name.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-LoPucki_Page_60-2) Registering the trade name with a relevant government body is often required.

In a number of countries, the phrase "**trading as**" (abbreviated to **t/a**) is used to designate a trade name. In the [United States](link_8), the phrase "**doing business as**" (abbreviated to **DBA**, **dba**, **d.b.a.**, or **d/b/a**) is used,[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-LoPucki_Page_60-2)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-Pinkerton-3) among others, such as **assumed business name**[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-4) or **fictitious business name**.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-5) In [Canada](link_9), "**operating as**" (abbreviated to **o/a**) and "_trading as_" are used, although "_doing business as_" is also sometimes used.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-business-registration-6)

A company typically uses a trade name to conduct business using a simpler name rather than its formal and often lengthier name. Trade names are also used when a preferred name cannot be registered, often because it may already be registered or is too similar to a name that is already registered.

Online platforms such as [Wix](link_10), Namelix, Looka, [LegalZoom](link_11), and [Elementor](link_12) also provide tools for creating and searching for trade names as part of establishing a business website.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-8)

## Legal aspects

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Trade_name&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Legal aspects")]

Using one or more fictitious business names does not create additional separate legal entities.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-Pinkerton-3) The distinction between a registered legal name and a fictitious business name, or trade name, is important because fictitious business names do not always identify the entity that is [legally responsible](link_13).

Legal agreements (such as [contracts](link_14)) are normally made using the registered legal name of the business. If a corporation fails to consistently adhere to such important legal formalities like using its registered legal name in contracts, it may be subject to [piercing of the corporate veil](link_15).[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-Plimpton-9)

In [English](link_16), trade names are generally treated as [proper nouns](link_17).[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-10)

## By country

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Trade_name&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: By country")]

### Argentina

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Trade_name&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Argentina")]

In [Argentina](link_18), a trade name is known as a _nombre de fantasía_ ('fantasy' or 'fiction' name), and the legal name of business is called a _razón social_ (social name).

### Australia

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Trade_name&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Australia")]

In [Australia](link_19), businesses are required to register any _business name_ that they operate under. The [Australian Securities and Investments Commission](link_20) manages the registration and approval of business names, which are linked to [Australian Business Number](link_21) records.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trade_name#cite_note-11)

# Applebee’s and IHOP’s Latest Dual-Branded Restaurant Opens in San Antonio

 Sep  15  2026 

 Industry News 

![Image 64: Dine Brands approaches 50 dual-branded Applebee’s | IHOP restaurants nationwide with newest opening.](https://www.fsrmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/ApplebeesIHOP.jpg)

 Dine Brands 

 Dine Brands approaches 50 dual-branded Applebee’s | IHOP restaurants nationwide with newest opening. 

Share:

[Tweet](https://twitter.com/share?url=https://www.fsrmagazine.com/industry-news/applebees-and-ihops-latest-dual-branded-restaurant-opens-in-san-antonio/&text=Applebee%E2%80%99s%20and%20IHOP%E2%80%99s%20Latest%20Dual-Branded%20Restaurant%20Opens%20in%20San%20Antonio "Share on Twitter")[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://www.fsrmagazine.com/industry-news/applebees-and-ihops-latest-dual-branded-restaurant-opens-in-san-antonio/&display=popup&ref=plugin&src=share_button "Share on Facebook")[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https://www.fsrmagazine.com/industry-news/applebees-and-ihops-latest-dual-branded-restaurant-opens-in-san-antonio/ "Share on LinkedIn")[Email](mailto:?subject=Your%20friend%20has%20shared%20an%20article%20with%20you.&body=Applebee%E2%80%99s%20and%20IHOP%E2%80%99s%20Latest%20Dual-Branded%20Restaurant%20Opens%20in%20San%20Antonio%0D%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fwww.fsrmagazine.com%2Findustry-news%2Fapplebees-and-ihops-latest-dual-branded-restaurant-opens-in-san-antonio%2F%0D%0A "Share via Email")

Dine Brands Global, Inc., the parent company of Applebee’s Neighborhood Grill + Bar and IHOP, celebrated the rapid expansion of its dual-branded restaurant concept with the opening of a new location in San Antonio, Texas. Less than two years after launching the first standalone U.S. dual-branded restaurant in nearby Seguin, Texas, the two iconic brands are approaching 50 dual-branded locations nationwide, reflecting growing guest demand for greater variety, convenience, and value under one roof.

Located at 2607 W. Loop 1604 S., the new restaurant is the eighth dual-branded Applebee’s | IHOP location in the greater San Antonio market, underscoring the region’s strong embrace of the concept. To celebrate the opening and the community, The Hakim Group, an Applebee’s and IHOP franchisee and location owner, hosted a special ribbon-cutting event where 100 guests received free pancakes for a year. The franchisee also presented a $1,000 donation to Stay Strong Foundation, a San Antonio-based nonprofit, reinforcing its commitment to supporting the local community.

“We are excited for guests to experience this newest Applebee’s | IHOP location, which reflects the continued evolution of the dual-branded concept,” said Danny Hakim, Vice President of The Hakim Group. “Our restaurants are only as strong as the communities they serve and we’re proud to continue investing in San Antonio and to support organizations that are making a difference locally.”

The dual-branded restaurant offers guests the best of both brands under one roof, allowing them to mix and match signature Applebee’s and IHOP items from a single menu any time of day, from morning to late night. Within the space, guests enjoy the unique identity and atmosphere of both brands, connected by shared spaces that create a seamless experience and complemented by specialty cocktails* and exclusive menu innovations available only at dual-branded locations, including the Loaded Buffalo Chicken Omelette and Ultimate Breakfast Burger.

“What began as a bold idea has evolved into a meaningful complement to our development and growth strategies,” said John Peyton, CEO of Dine Brands Global. “In under two years, we’ve gone from one dual-branded U.S. location to nearly 50 nationwide, and the momentum continues. By bringing Applebee’s and IHOP together under one roof, we’re creating a more flexible operating model, giving guests more reasons to visit, and offering franchisees an additional pathway to strengthen their businesses over time.”

As Dine Brands advances its development and growth strategies, the dual-branded model is emerging as a valuable addition to its portfolio. The company remains on track to open approximately 80 domestic dual-branded restaurants by the end of 2026.

 The Applebee's-IHOP approach has runway for hundreds of locations. 

# How Applebee’s and IHOP Gave Customers ‘Something They Didn’t Know They Wanted’

 Oct  1  2026 

 Feature 

![Image 64: The Applebee's-IHOP approach has runway for hundreds of locations.](https://www.fsrmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/ApplebeesIHOPINT.jpg)

 Dine Brands 

 The Applebee's-IHOP approach has runway for hundreds of locations. 

Share:

[Tweet](https://twitter.com/share?url=https://www.fsrmagazine.com/feature/how-applebees-and-ihop-gave-customers-something-they-didnt-know-they-wanted/&text=How%20Applebee%E2%80%99s%20and%20IHOP%20Gave%20Customers%20%E2%80%98Something%20They%20Didn%E2%80%99t%20Know%20They%20Wanted%E2%80%99 "Share on Twitter")[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://www.fsrmagazine.com/feature/how-applebees-and-ihop-gave-customers-something-they-didnt-know-they-wanted/&display=popup&ref=plugin&src=share_button "Share on Facebook")[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https://www.fsrmagazine.com/feature/how-applebees-and-ihop-gave-customers-something-they-didnt-know-they-wanted/ "Share on LinkedIn")[Email](mailto:?subject=Your%20friend%20has%20shared%20an%20article%20with%20you.&body=How%20Applebee%E2%80%99s%20and%20IHOP%20Gave%20Customers%20%E2%80%98Something%20They%20Didn%E2%80%99t%20Know%20They%20Wanted%E2%80%99%0D%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fwww.fsrmagazine.com%2Ffeature%2Fhow-applebees-and-ihop-gave-customers-something-they-didnt-know-they-wanted%2F%0D%0A "Share via Email")

John Peyton, sitting at Dine Brands HQ in Pasadena, California, was some 8,000 miles away from where the first dual-branded IHOP and Applebee’s sprung up in Dubai. Being so far from corporate, he said, meant the franchisee could veer from the playbook and ask for permission later.

Eagles Landing International Restaurants did just that as it designed and opened half a dozen “before we were even paying attention,” Peyton recalled. But, approval aside, he kept hearing positive things. A couple popped up in Mexico and Peyton hopped on a plane.

“[I] came back and said to the team, this is a really big idea,” he said. “And we opened the first one a year ago, April.”

Speaking at the Barclays Annual Global Consumer Staples Conference, Peyton walked through the much-talked-about model that’s provided Dine Brands a growth lane it hasn’t appreciated in a while. That overseas inspiration-[turned-stateside debut outside San Antonio](https://www.fsrmagazine.com/feature/franchisees-flock-to-applebees-ihop-combo-stores/), has 45 open today, with 80 projected by year’s end. All but three of them are conversions, meaning the original restaurant (Applebee’s or IHOP) added the second.

With close to 50 active, Dine Brands has been able to paint a steady economic impact for franchisees. It costs about $1 million to tack on (a bit more going from IHOP to Applebee’s thanks to the addition of a bar). And stores are seeing consistent revenue growth of 1.5 to 2.5X original gains. So, a $2 million IHOP becomes a $3 million combo.

The most compelling note for Peyton, he explained, is nobody walked into HQ and suggested putting an IHOP and Applebee’s in the same building, “because no one [would] ever think of that.”

Yet when examine the tickets, two-thirds are items from both sides of the menu. In the morning, combo restaurants are selling pancakes and ribs. In the evening, they’re moving omelets and skillets.

“And so, guests that are experiencing it are actually taking advantage of it,” Peyton said. “We’re giving them something they didn’t know they wanted. And we’ve got a very robust pipeline for next year as well.” He noted most combo stores are now serving Bloody Marys.

Peyton was asked about the deliberation process going forward. As leases come up, or franchisee agreements spin, Dine Brands is hosting conversations 12–24 months in advance on what might be next. It covers the typical queries. Should the store move? Has the market changed over the decades? But now, if operators do elect to continue (94 percent of Dine Brands’ agreements are renewed, Peyton said), the notion of a renovation or combo could enter the debate.

It’s likely that will happen more often in the years to come. Dine Brands projects 900 opportunities for IHOP-Applebee’s combo stores in the U.S. alone. Of those, 450 are new builds and 450 conversions (an existing brand adding the other).

When the company devised the 900 number, Peyton said, as you’d imagine, it built a big model in Pasadena with ample assumptions, market conditions, population growth, and traffic factors. It ran figures with the idea it wouldn’t approve any restaurant in danger of cannibalizing another. If Dine Brands had, for instance, done so with 5–10 percent impact, it would have come up with 1,600 potential outlets instead of 900 (IHOP ended Q2 with 1,813 restaurants and Applebee’s 1,557).

In other terms, a lot of franchisees can’t covert. An operator running an Applebee’s 2 miles from an IHOP won’t receive approval to do so.

Dine Brands isn’t lacking for internal interest, however. Regarding this note, Peyton said things have not unfolded exactly as expected. The company’s initial hypothesis was it would need to build a batch to prove out the concept and demonstrate numbers for franchisees. Then, it would likely have had to subsidize and incentive early operators.

The initial store Peyton mentioned, in Seguin, was a partnership with long-time IHOP franchisee Ramzi Hakim Group, an entity with 30-plus locations. Of note, there is also an Applebee’s-IHOP hybrid opened by TEAM Schostak Family Restaurants inside a hotel complex in downtown Detroit that launched in June 2018.

Ramzi Hakim Group previously purchased the local Applebee’s franchisee. So, they owned the market for both and could put a conversion anywhere it wanted to, avoiding the cannibalization fear. Dine Brands subsidized the first, as expected, and when it opened, flew down Applebee’s and IHOP franchisees who were typical developers for the area. Those 20 or so operators witnessed the combo opening in action.

“And our book of business built right from there,” Peyton said.

![Image 65](https://www.fsrmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/AppleIHOPINT2-1-1024x597.jpg)

Franchisees are flocking to the combo-store model.

In the end, Dine Brands didn’t have to fund 10 dual stores and the incentive to franchisees, regarding key numbers, “has been steadily declining.”

What’s been particularly impressive, Peyton added, is the franchisees who showed up for the debut are restaurateurs with “30 or 40 years” of experience and its largest franchisees, Flynn Group, Doherty Enterprises, and Thrive Restaurant Group. It’s a group (Flynn is the biggest franchisee in the world) directing hundreds—collectively thousands—of stores through multiple brands. “They saw the concept and they said, ‘there’s something going on here,’” Peyton said. “And they signed up.”

Simply, it has not been a hard sell for Dine Brands. There are operators, of course, among the 400 or so franchisees in the system, who continue to monitor progress. But the pipeline is plenty deep.

So much so, in fact, CFO Vance Chang said, Dine Brands today is in the process of creating a 2027 FDD for the Applebee’s-IHOP opportunity. By the time it releases, the company should have 100 open, Peyton said, with 30–40 live for nine to 12 months and, thus, providing enough stats to illustrate what’s been going on. “And we’ll bring in fresh franchisees that will probably tackle the open markets,” he said.

As this unfolds, Dine Brands continues to fine-tune the operational model. It’s working on a 2.0 combo approach based upon early lessons. Peyton said the company got it “80 percent right out of the gate.” Some key observations, though, were IHOP franchisees needed additional help running a bar. So, Dine Brands has been sending teams in to coach and rethought training. Operators, he said, viewed the bar as another cost center and didn’t think as much about the role of the bartender and how they build culture and welcome regulars. Servers had to learn how to sell drinks and deliver hospitality, too.

With Applebee’s, no matter how much corporate cautioned, Peyton said, it was difficult to anticipate what takes place at an IHOP on Saturday and Sunday mornings. “And the volume of work there is a surprise to them,” he said.

“And what’s surprising about it is everything at IHOP is scratch, right?” Peyton continued. “So, it’s all real eggs. There’s nothing formula there. And with breakfast, as you all know, it’s all scratch and almost everything is customer. Everybody does something to their eggs differently than how it’s listed on the menu or their packages.”

For Applebee’s kitchen staff, it was a whole new way of working.

Dine Brands is strengthening training based upon the hurdles. Additionally, it’s picked up insights around equipment configuration, like where a flat top might be relative to a fryer. “All sorts of tweaks going forward,” Peyton said.

If you haven’t visited an IHOP-Applebee’s combo, he explained, it’s like a casual-dining reimagining of the co-brand rush QSR ignited decades ago. Only here, it’s more of a daypart play to make locations relevant throughout.

There’s a combined menu that stretches from breakfast through late night and it mirrors, somewhat, the nostalgic Northeast diners where somebody can sit from dawn until break while ordering everything from ribs to pie and eggs.

The menu tints from blue to red as dayparts progress.

Staff is cross trained and customers sit wherever they want and order from either chain. “When other brands in the past have tried duals, like KFC and things like that, they’re competing dayparts,” Peyton said. “So, what’s compelling about this is Dine Brands just happens to own the premier AM and premier PM brand.”

IHOP, since its 1958 founding, has been trying to address dinner, he said. This gave IHOP franchisees a solution they’ve been searching for since Dwight D. Eisenhower was president.

Applebee’s gets to unlock a morning daypart and revenue opportunity it’s typically closed for. “In terms of making the box more productive 24/7—that’s exactly what it does,” Peyton said.

![Image 66: Stuffed French Toast flavors from IHOP.](https://www.fsrmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/StuffedFrenchToast-1-1024x597.jpg)

IHOP’s Stuffed French Toasted returned nationwide on September 14. 

**The solo picture (for both)**

Outside of Dine Brands’ dual-branded vision, Peyton began his presentation by talking about IHOP and the chain’s recent mobility. It outperformed Black Box benchmarks in sales and traffic in Q2 for the third consecutive period. Same-store sales lifted 1.5 percent on nearly flat transactions.

Off-premises grew 3.5 percent (fifth straight period of gains) and catering saw comps jump 22 percent, up from 16 percent the previous quarter.
